introHtml: Koozie classic C handle mugs bring rugged durability and a comfortable grip to your promotional drinkware. Made from heavy-gauge stainless steel or speckled enamel, these mugs are built for campsites, tailgates, and busy offices. The iconic C-shaped handle makes them easy to hold, even with gloves. Choose full-color imprint or classic debossing to display your logo, and order in bulk for trade shows, employee gifts, or client appreciation. Koozie’s trusted quality ensures your brand stands out on every mug.
